{{Top}}
'''Blue Eight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the eighth member of [[Blue Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Blue Eight.

During the evacuation of Hoth, [[Beryann Raleg]] used the callsign. It was used by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Blue Eight (Defiance)|fighter pilot]] stationed onboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] who was killed in the months leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
